Sophia Rivera: Quick intake for new model candidate zephyr-13b (Mistral-derivative). Summary: quantized int8 on A100 looked promising — ~12% token cost reduction, ~2.1% regression on summarization BLEU-like metric. Request: prioritization + bring-up checklist + prompt/template for tool calling + structured-output schema. Pasting minimal chat template and schema we used for evals.

Matt Chen: Drop the minimal structured schema and example mapping we should enforce at API layer.

Sophia Rivera: ```
# chat template (pseudocode)
system: "You are Redwood Assist. Always return JSON matching the 'redwood_response' schema when asked for structured output."
user: "Summarize the following article and extract 'title' and 'entities'. If you call tools, return the tool output under 'tool_result' field."
assistant: (model may call tool)
```

Sophia Rivera: Example response expected from model (single-line JSON):
```json
{"title":"...","summary":"...","entities":[{"text":"...","type":"PERSON"}],"tool_result":{"source":"web_search","items":[...]}}
```

Ana Gomez: Any safety/regression flags from the eval runs?

eval-bot: safety: no new P0s. hallucination_rate: +0.7% on knowledge bench (small sample). rouge/bleu deltas: -2.1% summarization, -0.8% Q&A accuracy. perf: latency p95 +6ms on long contexts. Link: https://redwood.internal/ev/zephyr-13b

Li Patel: For API integration notes: use function_call style naming exactly as the schema 'redwood_response'; set response_mode=structured. If parse fails, fallback to 'text' mode and capture raw output in logs. Also ensure streaming chunking doesn't split JSON (use final delimiter token). Example flag:
```
{"response_mode":"structured","function_call":"redwood_response","fallback":"text_on_parse_error"}
```

Matt Chen: Nice. Also add a canary rollout with 10% traffic, enable compare evals on live traffic for sampling prompts.

Sophia Rivera: Will create PR with:
- [ ] canonical JSON schema (redwood_response)
- [ ] chat templates (system/user/examples)
- [ ] quantization config used (int8 w/ per-channel approx)
- [ ] bench comparisons (before/after + delta table)
- [ ] safety checklist and manual eval pass
- [ ] canary rollout plan (10% + rollback criteria)

Sophia Rivera: Tagging @eng-platform for routing rules and @eng-runtime for kernel selection guidance. :rocket:
